title: Real weights under shared subdivision
claim: With arbitrary nonzero real weights on a knot's tuples, under shared subdivision of the triangular-lattice torus (the 122 S2 and S1 rule shapes of SHARED-SUBDIVISION-20261029-001A): (1) every weighting is gauge-equivalent to one of 944 sign classes times 1 to 4 free positive magnitudes; (2) positive weights have the counted supports, so they are exact or support-exact only on the 22 counted-exact shapes at scale 2 (coarse sides 2-4) and the 6 twisted not-all-equal pairs at scale 3 (sides 2-3); (3) if every fine extension of a coarse-forbidden assignment uses each tuple equally often mod 2, no real weighting cancels it: this excludes 54 of the 100 non-affine shapes at scale 2 (coarse sides 2-3) and 34 shapes at scale 3 (side 2), and asking for one sign-coherent witness per sign class excludes nothing more; (4) on the 22 affine shapes the exact real weightings are exactly the gauge images of the exact plus-minus-one classes, at scale 2 on coarse sides 2-6 and at scale 3 on sides 2-4; sides 2-4 alone admit one more class for each parity law on up triangles (slice magnitudes 2^(1/9) and 2^(-1/3)), and the coarse 2-torus alone admits golden-ratio (scale 3) and reciprocal-tribonacci (scale 2) weightings of every sign class of the twisted pairs, all removed by larger tori; (5) the atoms excluding 000 or 111, weighted on Hamming classes, have no exact weighting on the coarse 2-torus. Left open: 46 shapes at scale 2 (atoms and two-excluded laws) and 82 non-affine shapes at scale 3.
failure_conditions: A positive weighting whose support differs from the counted support on a tested torus.
A shape listed as excluded by the sign-parity obstruction whose witness fails when recomputed (an extension with a different usage parity, or an allowed coarse assignment).
A real exact weighting of an affine shape, on the stated coarse sides, that is not gauge-equivalent to an exact plus-minus-one class (or the reverse).
A nonzero real solution of the symmetric-slice systems on the coarse 2-torus.
foundation_claim_scope: Weighted three-bit laws (arbitrary nonzero real weights on a knot's tuples) on the triangular-lattice torus, S2 and S1 rule shapes of SHARED-SUBDIVISION-20261029-001A; exactness and support-exactness under shared subdivision at scale 2 and 3 on the stated coarse tori.

validation.status: checked: 944 sign classes and gauge slices; counted support census (residues modulo three primes) and a random positive-weight control; sign-parity witnesses by single-tuple sign flips, exact integers by the Chinese remainder theorem, at scale 2 (coarse sides 2, 3) and scale 3 (side 2), plus the per-class refinement; explicit solution sets of the 22 affine shapes checked complete against trace(T^L) on L = 2-6, 8, 9, 10, 12; exact algebra (gcd and real roots, lexicographic Groebner bases, minimal polynomials) on coarse sides 2-6 (scale 2) and 2-4 (scale 3); symmetric slices by gcd and resultants; controls fire; no human or external review
validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-10-29.
